messages:
Elliot: Proposal: lift runtime soft-pin for mixed-quant llm group to 2.19.0 in the 03:00 UTC change window. Posting short risk checklist + rollout plan here.

Hana: What are the main changes in 2.19.0? Any runtime-binding changes that could break old SDKs?

Elliot: 2.19.0 includes a new tokenizer-aligned attention path (improves throughput for long-context), a change to KV TTL heuristics, and a perf fix for small-batch tail. No surface ABI changes.

Ops-Lina: KV TTL changes previously caused cache miss storms for prefix-warm workloads. Are we adding a grace toggle?

Elliot: Yes, we'll enable kv.grace=on for the canary to smooth initial eviction. We'll also bump cache TTL by 10% during the first hour.

Marco: Rollout: 1% smoke for 10m, 8% for 30m, 30% for 45m, full. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx>0.4% sustained 5m, p95 latency > baseline+60ms 10m, or mem-slope >6% over 10m.

DeployBot: Scheduled plan: action=soft-unpin runtime=2.19.0 model_group=mixed-quant window=2026-03-24T03:00:00Z traffic_ramp=[1,8,30,100] rollback_triggers=["5xx>0.4%5m","p95>60ms10m","mem_slope>6%10m"] runbook=/runbooks/2-19-unpin.md

Hana: SDK note: python-sdk v5 ok, node-sdk v6 has streaming chunk reordering test failures — marking node-sdk v6 incompatible until patch. I'll open shim PR.

Elliot: Good catch. Also running pinlist-scan now: `./infra/pinlist --type=runtime --from=2.18.0 --to=2.19.0`

DeployBot: Pinlist-scan results: 5 customer pins (agent-v2), 2 internal service pins. SEs alerted.

Ops-Lina: For customer pins, can we auto-apply soft-exempt for this window so they don't get moved to canary?

DeployBot: Soft-exempt applied for window=2026-03-24T03:00:00Z to matched pinsets. Notifications sent.

Marco: Who owns the rollback decision? DeployBot will auto-rollback; Ops-Lina and oncall-sre get pager and must ack the incident before further ramps.

Ops-Lina: I'll be on watch and will coordinate post-rollback validation. Also will mute non-essential internal load tests.

Docs-Rae: I'll add release note lines: "runtime 2.19.0: tokenizer-aligned attention, KV TTL heuristics changed, potential initial cache miss increase; node-sdk v6 streaming incompatibility noted." Drafting PR now.

Elliot: Final check at 02:30 UTC. If no new pinlist hits and SDK patch lands, we proceed. Tagging thread action:unpin-2-19-nightwatch.

Hana: Acknowledge. Will follow up on node-sdk shim and post status.
